Marine Anon here... this is nothing to get spun up about. II Marine Expeditionary Force (II MEF) is aligned to US European Command and does train to fight in Europe, as well as other places. Although this was a significant exercise, a MEFEX is not uncommon... its a recurring training exercise that occurs in many different forms. In 2018, II MEF participated in NATO exercise Trident Juncture in Norway. MEFEX 21.1 is basically a "replay" of that exercise (more or less) within the U.S, which saves us a ton of money. MEFEX 21.1 also did not involve a lot of "live" forces. Essentially this MEFEX was an exercise focused on planning and coordination, rather than exercising command and control over live forces... which also saves a ton of money.

Trust me on this, MEFEX is NOT in any way a training exercise to use USMC (or any other) forces on U.S. soil for any reason. There's lots of open source info on Trident Juncture as well as various past MEFEX's.
